text: ; soluble in alcohol. Store in airtight con- tainers. Profile Gramicidin has properties similar to those of tyrothricin (p.358) and is too toxic to be given systemically. It is used topically for the local treatment of susceptible infections usually with other antibacterials such as neomycin and polymyxin B, and often with a corticosteroid as well.
